architecture_contract.warning: Sei emits one 21907-element vector for the center of a 4096-bp sequence. It does not emit a nucleotide- or bin-resolved accessibility profile.

conversion_contract.future_conversion_rule: Any safetensors or modern-runtime conversion is a separately named artifact. It must reproduce all 21907 raw probabilities, target order, 40 raw projections, histone-normalized ALT-minus-REF projections, and strand means on fixed hg38 fixtures before replacing the native path.

input_contract.allele_checks: Normalize variants, require GRCh38.p14 REF matching, make VCF and BED coordinate conventions explicit, and reject unresolved multiallelic or indel alignment cases.
input_contract.window_boundary_rule: Use explicit N padding and a held-block boundary buffer of at least 4096 bp.

output_contract.profile_limit: Outputs are center-bin peak probabilities, not continuous DNase/ATAC counts, insertion profiles, or multinomial profiles.

reference_contract.reference_gate: Do not use the released FASTA blindly. Freeze its member hash after approved acquisition and prove primary-contig sequence identity, contig naming, coordinate conventions, and REF alleles against GRCh38.p14.

runtime_contract.warning: The broad lower bounds are not an executable environment lock. Freeze an exact compatible runtime without changing native math before admission.

safe_loading_contract.archive_gate: After campaign approval, verify 3281639255 bytes, published MD5, and computed SHA-256 before opening. Inventory with traversal, absolute-path, link, duplicate-path, member-count, per-member-size, and expanded-size limits.
safe_loading_contract.auxiliary_arrays: Load only expected numeric NPY arrays with object/pickle loading disabled; freeze path, SHA-256, shape, dtype, finite-value checks, and target-order dimensions.
safe_loading_contract.checkpoint_risk: The expected .pth file is a Python pickle container. Never call unrestricted torch.load on an untrusted archive. Inspect in an isolated no-network runtime, require a tensor-only state dictionary, freeze key/shape/dtype inventory, and convert only through a separately audited parity path.
safe_loading_contract.network_policy: No runtime network fetches or archive extraction in a model process.

source_evidence: The Nature Genetics article, pinned official repository, and immutable Zenodo model, training-data, and reference-resource records were queried on 2026-08-22. No archive, checkpoint, package, training data, or FASTA was downloaded or deserialized.

task_fit.signed_eqtl_ieqtl: not_native; a signed gene-effect model requires a nonsealed development head plus a separately frozen enhancer-gene and direction contract

terms_audit.code: Academic and research use only; commercial use requires contact with Princeton licensing.
terms_audit.derivative_release: The official code path is not eligible for the open champion. A clean-room implementation using the CC-BY-4.0 weight artifact would be a new identity requiring legal review, tensor parity, attribution, and redistribution audit.
terms_audit.training_data: Zenodo 4907038 declares CC-BY-4.0, while the official README additionally requires agreement to Cistrome Project terms before downloading processed Cistrome training data.

training_contract.label_type: binary presence or absence of each regulatory-profile peak at the two-base center
training_contract.training_corpus: 19905 Cistrome-processed profiles plus 2002 profiles processed by ENCODE and Roadmap; more than 1300 cell lines and tissues
training_contract.warning: The released training configuration declares this split, but exact checkpoint-to-config parity and the full accession/run alias manifest remain unresolved.

variant_scoring_contract.common_lane: Emit prespecified raw REF, ALT, and ALT-minus-REF 21907-track features under identical windows and strand means; fit identical heads only in development donor and LD/genomic folds.
variant_scoring_contract.native_lane: Compute the official histone-nucleosome-adjusted 40-class score as ALT minus REF using the exact projection vectors and histone-index array.
variant_scoring_contract.signed_effect_limit: A positive Sei track or sequence-class delta is a predicted chromatin change, not a signed target-gene eQTL or ieQTL effect.
variant_scoring_contract.track_and_class_selection: Liver/intestine E9 or any profile subset is frozen without sealed outcomes and reported alongside the full prespecified feature path.
